purpose: Preserve valid ecological signal without using every reviewer sensitivity as a fail-closed veto. Robustness analyses grade evidence strength; they do not automatically erase the estimand tested by the frozen global primary analysis.
primary_estimand: Within-source-assigned-taxon spatial environment-trait association in the frozen global spatially thinned cohort.
headline_framework: continuous within-taxon phenomics plus trait- and scale-specific environmental structure

A_robust.definition: Global primary support plus same-direction support across relevant timing/taxon-composition sensitivities and no material contradiction in range or measurement-quality sensitivity.
A_robust.manuscript_use: May be emphasized as the strongest concrete environmental association.

B_supported_but_sensitive.definition: Supported in the frozen global primary or spatial analysis, but one restricted-domain sensitivity loses multiplicity support while retaining direction, or effect magnitude changes materially without sign reversal.
B_supported_but_sensitive.manuscript_use: Retain as an environmental association with an explicit sensitivity qualifier; do not call it withdrawn solely because a restricted-domain BH threshold is missed.

C_exploratory_continuous_signal.definition: Tier-wise FDR-supported candidate continuous image phenotype, or a coherent repeated signal across related metrics, but endpoint-specific image-quality or botanical validation remains incomplete.
C_exploratory_continuous_signal.manuscript_use: Report as exploratory/provisional image-derived signal and use to motivate validation; not a confirmatory botanical-function claim.

D_unresolved_or_artifact_prone.definition: Association shows important sign reversal across quality/resolution strata, fails basic measurement integrity, or is not reproducible under the relevant model definition.
D_unresolved_or_artifact_prone.manuscript_use: Do not use as a positive biological result; retain only as provenance or a measurement-design warning.

validation_only.definition: Surface/exudate/indumentum image signals that lack botanical reference calibration.
validation_only.manuscript_use: Coverage and calibration only; no ecological trait claim.

sensitivity_rules.season_and_dominant_taxa: Same-sign persistence increases robustness. Magnitude changes are reported rather than treated as automatic failure.
sensitivity_rules.hemisphere_timing: Same-sign persistence increases robustness. This does not substitute for developmental-stage annotation.
sensitivity_rules.native_range: A native-only restriction is a restricted-domain sensitivity, not the primary estimand. Loss of BH support with preserved sign is classified as range-sensitive rather than automatically withdrawn. Sign reversal or a large incompatible effect requires stronger downgrading.
sensitivity_rules.image_resolution_and_sharpness: Quality adjustment and fixed resolution strata directly probe measurement bias. Loss of BH support alone lowers confidence; sign reversal across plausible strata is stronger evidence of artifact-proneness.
sensitivity_rules.independent_reference_validation: Required before image proxies are renamed as botanical quantities, but absence of calibration does not erase a clearly labelled image-derived ecological association.
sensitivity_rules.repeat_photos: Used to quantify image-condition contribution to visible variance. It does not redefine the global environmental estimand unless it reveals a systematic environment-linked measurement artifact.
sensitivity_rules.colour_negative_control: Required before a corolla-specific optical mechanism is claimed. A failed control constrains colour specificity; it does not automatically erase all image-colour environmental structure.

claim_boundaries: No phenotypic plasticity claim from cross-sectional spatial associations.
No local adaptation or selection claim without fitness/genetic evidence.
No pollinator or antagonist causation from macroecological associations.
No botanical spine, phyllary-angle, indumentum or mucilage identity from unvalidated image proxies.
No resolved phylogenetic correction from grafted trees with sparse direct-backbone coverage.
decision_principle: Use robustness controls to rank confidence and delimit interpretation, not to reduce the biological narrative to only coefficients that pass every possible sensitivity threshold.
